reason: B is the better proposal because it directly targets a homogeneous BCC solid solution, defines clearer mechanical and helium-implantation conditions, and tests all required tradeoffs against NbMoTaW; A instead relies on deliberately induced segregation/precipitates that could undermine phase stability and ductility.
